messages:
maya: Starting a microbatch for the q4b bringup focused on promptset curation + quant smoke. Pulling from legacy seedbank C to stress multimodal edgecases.

simon: awesome. what's the sampling recipe?

maya: using stratified intent sampling: 40% high-recall, 40% rare-intent, 20% multimodal anchors. command: `./tools/sampler --cohort C --strata high,rare,multi --p 0.5 --dedupe fuzzyhash:0.95`.

irene: labeler load? we have a small tagging sprint today so capacity might be tight. current queue 29.

maya: noted. marking anchors `prio:soft` and enabling `overlap-guard`. also adding `expect_review:manual` flag for any gold candidates.

simon: for evals attach model_metadata (model_name, quant_profile, kernel_tag) and `prompt_family` so we can slice regressions. Also log token-level diffs.

maya: payload schema enforced via `validate_json --require model_name,quant_profile,prompt_family`. logging to s3://redwood-curation/curation/6890012345/.

ops-bot: microbatch 6890012345 registered. sampling complete. dedupe job queued. ETA dedupe ~18m.

irene: after dedupe can we run a micro A/B vs the holdout golden (n=400) and capture accuracy delta + bootstrap CI?

simon: yes, set `n=400` and `metric=qa-f1,answer-precision`. compare q4b-int4 against q4b-fp16 baseline.

maya: scheduling that now. timeline: dedupe 18m, routing 6m, validation 4m, micro-eval ~45m. will update thread with the CI table and any anomalous prompts. :mag:
